format: 1-vs-1 snake race on a neon 20x22 grid: two snakes hunt the same orbs (+1), a mid-race star is +4, any crash = BONK, lose 40% of your length and the tail spills as crumbs the rival can eat; first to 30 long wins. Top title + live status line, two race-lane progress bars at the bottom, slow-mo final bite, winner card, loop blend
theme: fire vs ice (elemental head-to-head matchup, favorite with a head start vs underdog, retro snake game)
viral_reason: VARIETY_RULES rule 2 own results: Windsor last_30dT for eas.ydata shows the 1-vs-1 'X vs Y, only one wins' matchups (Country Clash, ~1.4-1.6k views) beating 8-entrant races and mazes (~130-160 views) by ~10x, so this is a head-to-head favorite-vs-underdog race; the theme comes from rule 3 (instantly readable matchup + nostalgic retro game) because countries cannot run twice and food was already used twice today. No aislop/research/latest.md in the Project.
music_style: synthwave: 108 bpm, B minor, detuned saw pads, saw eighth-note bass, 808 kit; fire bites = warm plucks, ice bites = glass bells climbing the scale with length, bonks = sub thump + pitch slide, saw stab on lead changes; drums drop out for the slow-mo final bite
caption:
Welcome to the snake pit: Fire against Ice, and the first one to 30 segments long takes it.

Fire gets a two-segment head start. Both hunt the same glowing orbs, a mid-race star is worth +4, and any crash snaps off 40% of your tail for the other side to eat. The lead does not stay put.

Team Fire or Team Ice?

#snakegame #firevsice #retrogames #simulation #satisfying
